incidents.name: Orion ExchangeWithOrionPool depositAsset reentrancy
incidents.notes: swapThroughOrionPool() executed a caller-supplied token path with no reentrancy guard, so the attacker's fake ATK token re-entered depositAsset() from its transfer hook and credited the exchange balance repeatedly for funds that were only paid once, after which the inflated balance was withdrawn.

sources.ref: onchain review: exchange proxy 0xb5599f568d3f3e6113b286d010d2bca40a7745aa created 2020-12-06 by 0x33459acd9ca8493c0e0163eac92a928e293b2218 (Orion deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0x837962b686fd5a407fb4e5f92e8be86a230484bd; 11 EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident, the last on 2022-12-13 to implementation 0x98a877bb507f19eb43130b688f522a13885cf604, so the exploited code was ~51 days old; a parallel BSC tx (0xfb153c572e304093023b4f9694ef39135b6ed5b2515453173e81ec02df2e2104) hit the same flaw
